summary: Hybrid export may admit a published, document-completed authored deck whose valid passed V2 gate has non-empty unique in-range verbatim_flag_only flags and whose sealed V3 blockers contain only visualReview.failed or providerCalls.slide_budget_invalid:<n>.
invariants: The presentation lifecycle is DB-authoritatively published and the authored gate is documentStatus completed with documentCompleted true.
The V2 gate validates its digest and policy binding and has gatePassed true.
flaggedSlides is non-empty and every entry has remakeOutcome verbatim_flag_only with a unique integer index in the declared slideCount range.
The sealed V3 receipt has gatePassed false and every blocker is exactly visualReview.failed or providerCalls.slide_budget_invalid:<n>.
The V3 digest is checked after the compatibility predicate and must remain valid.
forbidden: This is not a generic Hybrid bypass; any other blocker, invalid V2 evidence, invalid V3 digest, invalid flag entry, or non-published lifecycle refuses export.
This decision narrows and does not supersede public-export.fidelity-visual-review-pending or public-export.legacy-fidelity-quality-compatibility.
